fusions.name: Thrown Hatchet
fusions.desc: Throws a hatchet that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, and slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and each kill returns one.

fusions.name: Hock Cut
fusions.desc: Rushes you up to 6 tiles to the target and chops low for 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound and [Bleeding] for 6 seconds. The bleeding worsens while the target moves.

fusions.name: Dropped Timber
fusions.desc: Fells a trunk 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Past the Hinge
fusions.desc: Against enemies below half health, you deal 12% more damage.
